diagnostics.geometry: Actual position/normal/index arrays must exactly equal look.glassSlabGeometry(w,h,t,r,{tessellate:.002}) from the live product module; full bounds and front/back/side triangle categories must remain. Export hashes and counts. Compare actual bounds with reference geometry bounds, not nominal t: the product extrusion minimum can add 0.01mm beyond nominal thickness. Export nominal thickness, actual depth and difference separately.
diagnostics.shader: Exact vertex/fragment equality with live product glassMaterial factory, backdrop uniform object identity, original shader side/depthWrite, and no legacy cut-mask code/uniforms.
diagnostics.pixelContribution: Sample actual front, side or back triangle centroids below the title. Camera-facing triangles and body ray hits define isolated surface ROI; first-hit among all complete body meshes defines unoccluded scene ROI. Compare original shader to body absent under a separate no-env neutral background. Do not change geometry or shader to obtain a pass.
diagnostics.emptyRoiPolicy: If canonical overlap leaves fewer than24 unoccluded sampled body pixels, full-scene contribution is N/A for that level/view. All original geometry/shader and isolated full-body contribution checks remain mandatory. Never mutate Catalog to manufacture exposure. N/A must not be reported as full-scene contribution proof.
diagnostics.restoration: Exact original uOpacity/uniform snapshot, object visibility, HDR environment and complete original HDR beauty pixel readback after diagnostics.

matrixGate.rule: Historical RGB threshold retained: each rear level needs a view with exposed ROI >=24, changed pixels >=20 and max RGB difference >=3 before any RGB matrix pass. Initial R8 scope is two reference conditions only; no six/eight-view pass is inherited, and alpha contribution cannot replace RGB visibility.

diagnostics.legacyRGBFailurePolicy: Record FAIL or N/A explicitly, without lowering thresholds or manufacturing exposure. The source product legacyRGB9/max2 failure is separate historical evidence, not the observation of this runner.

rgbaProposal.method: Same original shader, canonical geometry/camera and actual opacity in separate transparent RGBA target; full-scene on versus opacity-zero and body-removed negative control at the same exposed ROI; original HDR beauty restored. Never default-framebuffer RGB visibility.
rgbaProposal.threeZonePolicy: Split the actual isolated body projected x span into3 equal zones; export each zone samples/change/max. Three-zone applicable only if each has>=24 exposed samples; each needs>=20 changed pixels for separate three-zone pass. Missing exposure is N/A, never fill through geometry/camera changes.
